description: Central Provincial Council - Notify the draft of the Establishment of Waste Management Authority Statute, No. 04 of 2017
categorisation: The gazette content primarily concerns the publication of a draft statute (the Waste Management Authority Statute No. 04 of 2017) for the Central Province. This falls under the category of new laws, acts, and regulations, which is the defining characteristic of Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5). While a government official's name and title are mentioned, the core content is the legal framework for establishing a new authority, not a government personnel change or a detailed assignment of ministerial portfolios.
